# Groupe Scolaire Les Lumières (مجموعة مدارس الأنوار)

> Private trilingual school (French, Arabic, English) in Tangier, Morocco, founded in 2004. One campus covers preschool (maternelle), primary, middle school (collège) and high school (lycée). Known for Cambridge English preparation, Singapore Maths and a caring, closely followed education.

## Key facts

- Official name: Groupe Scolaire Les Lumières — Arabic: مجموعة مدارس الأنوار
- Type: private school (école privée) following the Moroccan curriculum up to the Baccalauréat, with Cambridge English and international options
- Founded: 2004 (22 years of experience in 2026)
- Location: Ribh2, Avenue Moulay Rachid, Val Fleuri, 90060 Tanger, Morocco (GPS 35.7595, -5.834)
- Cycles: Maternelle (PS, MS, GS) · Primaire (CP to CE6) · Collège International (1AC to 3AC) · Lycée (Tronc Commun, 1er Bac, 2ème Bac)
- Languages: French (main language), Arabic from preschool, English from GS with Cambridge Preparation
- Teaching methods: Montessori approach in preschool, Singapore Maths in primary, Cambridge English Qualifications track
- Services: school canteen, school transport, computer rooms and science laboratories
- Activities: theatre, Albatros choir, arts, sports competitions, 3 school trips a year, annual events
- Admissions: open for 2026-2027; pre-registration form online or by WhatsApp
- Phone: +212 539 93 90 95 · WhatsApp: +212 666 63 69 74 · Email: leslumieres2021@gmail.com
- Office hours: Monday–Thursday 08:00–17:00, Saturday 09:00–13:00; school day 08:45–12:30
